narrative: I started methotrexate 15 mg once weekly about six weeks ago for my rheumatoid arthritis. Over the past two weeks I have developed painful mouth sores, unusual tiredness, and mild nausea. My rheumatologist prescribed folic acid 1 mg daily to take alongside the methotrexate. She told me I must not take ibuprofen or any other NSAIDs while on methotrexate because they can be dangerous together. I used to take ibuprofen 400 mg occasionally for joint pain before starting this treatment but stopped completely when I began the methotrexate. I take no other prescription medications.
